model_name: Zahirovic et al. (2022) rotation model; Cao et al. (2017) paleogeography
original_format: ZIP archive (GPML, shapefile, rotation, NetCDF members)
spatial_resolution: Vector polygons at native source resolution; seafloor age grid 6 arc-minute
temporal_resolution: Continuous rotation model (finite-rotation poles stored from 0 Ma back past the Phanerozoic, evaluated at any age); Cao et al. paleogeography intervals 2-402 Ma
license: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record); the EarthByte page states CC BY 3.0
citation: EarthByte Group, GPlates 2.5.0 GeoData, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.8307322; rotation model: Zahirovic et al. 2022, doi:10.1002/gdj3.146
processing_method: Unzipped unchanged. Static polygons, coastlines, continental polygons and Cao et al. layers reconstructed with pygplates 1.0.0 (RotationModel.reconstruct, DateLineWrapper), simplified to about 0.03-0.15 degree and written as GeoJSON by scripts/build_deeptime_data.py

original_format: ZIP archive (GPML, shapefile, rotation, NetCDF members)
spatial_resolution: Raster maps 3600 x 1800 px (0.1 degree) and global plate polygons
temporal_resolution: 90 paleogeographic maps, 0-750 Ma (5 Myr steps through most of the Mesozoic and Cenozoic); plate model poles in the file reach 1100 Ma
license: Not stated on the download page; credit the PALEOMAP Project
citation: Scotese, C.R., 2016. PALEOMAP PaleoAtlas for GPlates and the PaleoData Plotter Program, PALEOMAP Project, http://www.earthbyte.org/paleomap-paleoatlas-for-gplates/
processing_method: Unzipped unchanged. The nearest published map for each frame age is used without interpolation; JPGs are georeferenced as global 0.1-degree rasters (paleo-coordinates). Rotation file read with pygplates

citation: Cohen, K.M., Finney, S.C., Gibbard, P.L. and Fan, J.-X. (2013; updated) The ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart. Episodes 36: 199-204
processing_method: Kept as the official reference; boundary ages used in the app are read from the Macrostrat ICS-derived interval files and cross-checked against the chart text
